iommu/arm-smmu-v3: Avoid constructing invalid range commands

Although io-pgtable's non-leaf invalidations are always for full tables,
I missed that SVA also uses non-leaf invalidations, while being at the
mercy of whatever range the MMU notifier throws at it. This means it
definitely wants the previous TTL fix as well, since it also doesn't
know exactly which leaf level(s) may need invalidating, but it can also
give us less-aligned ranges wherein certain corners may lead to building
an invalid command where TTL, Num and Scale are all 0. It should be fine
to handle this by over-invalidating an extra page, since falling back to
a non-range command opens up a whole can of errata-flavoured worms.

Fixes: 6833b8f2e199 ("iommu/arm-smmu-v3: Set TTL invalidation hint better")
Reported-by: Rui Zhu <zhurui3@huawei.com>
Signed-off-by: Robin Murphy <robin.murphy@arm.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/b99cfe71af2bd93a8a2930f20967fb2a4f7748dd.1694432734.git.robin.murphy@arm.com
Signed-off-by: Will Deacon <will@kernel.org>

iommu/arm-smmu-v3: Set TTL invalidation hint better

When io-pgtable unmaps a whole table, rather than waste time walking it
to find the leaf entries to invalidate exactly, it simply expects
.tlb_flush_walk with nominal last-level granularity to invalidate any
leaf entries at higher intermediate levels as well. This works fine with
page-based invalidation, but with range commands we need to be careful
with the TTL hint - unconditionally setting it based on the given level
3 granule means that an invalidation for a level 1 table would strictly
not be required to affect level 2 block entries. It's easy to comply
with the expected behaviour by simply not setting the TTL hint for
non-leaf invalidations, so let's do that.

Signed-off-by: Robin Murphy <robin.murphy@arm.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/b409d9a17c52dc0db51faee91d92737bb7975f5b.1685637456.git.robin.murphy@arm.com
Signed-off-by: Will Deacon <will@kernel.org>

	tristate "ARM Ltd. System MMU Version 3 (SMMUv3) Support"
	depends on ARM64
	select IOMMU_API
	select IOMMU_IO_PGTABLE_LPAE
	select GENERIC_MSI_IRQ
	help
	  Support for implementations of the ARM System MMU architecture

	  Say Y here if your system includes an IOMMU device implementing

config ARM_SMMU_V3_SVA
	bool "Shared Virtual Addressing support for the ARM SMMUv3"
	depends on ARM_SMMU_V3
	select IOMMU_SVA
	select MMU_NOTIFIER
	help
	  Support for sharing process address spaces with devices using the
	  SMMUv3.

	  Say Y here if your system supports SVA extensions such as PCIe PASID
	  and PRI.

/*
	 * arch_invalidate_secondary_tlbs() is used to manage a non-CPU TLB
	 * which shares page-tables with the CPU. The
	 * invalidate_range_start()/end() callbacks should not be implemented as
	 * invalidate_secondary_tlbs() already catches the points in time when
	 * an external TLB needs to be flushed.
	 *
	 * This requires arch_invalidate_secondary_tlbs() to be called while
	 * holding the ptl spin-lock and therefore this callback is not allowed
	 * to sleep.
	 *
	 * This is called by architecture code whenever invalidating a TLB
	 * entry. It is assumed that any secondary TLB has the same rules for
	 * when invalidations are required. If this is not the case architecture
	 * code will need to call this explicitly when required for secondary
	 * TLB invalidation.
	 */
	void (*arch_invalidate_secondary_tlbs)(
					struct mmu_notifier *subscription,
					struct mm_struct *mm,
					unsigned long start,
					unsigned long end);

line_facts.claim_zh: 同版ARM64单页TLB路径向公共notifier传入对齐后的恰好一PAGE_SIZE范围；这给SVA短范围提供真实源码入口，但没有执行该调用链。
ARM64范围入口按stride对齐、完成CPU失效后仍向公共notifier交付整个start/end，而不会交付CPU具体指令的Num/Scale编码。

line_facts.claim_zh: SVA绑定domain/mm时注册arch_invalidate_secondary_tlbs回调；这是运行时注册边，需SVA启用且绑定成功。
SVA从end-start转成size，只有!BTM且size非零才调用范围函数，PAGE_SIZE是名义粒度、leaf=false；size为零使用ASID全失效，BTM开启跳过该SMMU TLBI编码路径但仍调用ATC失效。
io-pgtable清除一个非叶表项时传入整表覆盖size与名义最末级granule；走公共tlb_flush_walk回调，SMMU回调传leaf=false。

evidence.text:
/**
 * struct iommu_flush_ops - IOMMU callbacks for TLB and page table management.
 *
 * @tlb_flush_all:  Synchronously invalidate the entire TLB context.
 * @tlb_flush_walk: Synchronously invalidate all intermediate TLB state
 *                  (sometimes referred to as the "walk cache") for a virtual
 *                  address range.
 * @tlb_add_page:   Optional callback to queue up leaf TLB invalidation for a
 *                  single page.  IOMMUs that cannot batch TLB invalidation
 *                  operations efficiently will typically issue them here, but
 *                  others may decide to update the iommu_iotlb_gather structure
 *                  and defer the invalidation until iommu_iotlb_sync() instead.
 *
 * Note that these can all be called in atomic context and must therefore
 * not block.
 */
struct iommu_flush_ops {
	void (*tlb_flush_all)(void *cookie);
	void (*tlb_flush_walk)(unsigned long iova, size_t size, size_t granule,
			       void *cookie);
	void (*tlb_add_page)(struct iommu_iotlb_gather *gather,
			     unsigned long iova, size_t granule, void *cookie);

line_facts.claim_zh: 设备IDR5给出支持粒度；域用该bitmap创建io-pgtable，io-pgtable优先CPU PAGE_SIZE但可选其他支持粒度，域保存筛过的bitmap。编码TG来自域bitmap最小位，不是无条件CPU PAGE_SHIFT。
PAGE_SIZE由ARM64配置的12/14/16移位形成，分别4/16/64KiB；这是同一CPU架构内配置差异，不能当成三个CPU架构。

evidence.text:
#define ARM_SMMU_IDR3			0xc
#define IDR3_RIL			(1 << 10)

#define ARM_SMMU_IDR5			0x14
#define IDR5_STALL_MAX			GENMASK(31, 16)
#define IDR5_GRAN64K			(1 << 6)
#define IDR5_GRAN16K			(1 << 5)
#define IDR5_GRAN4K			(1 << 4)

* When the CPU does not support TLB range operations, flush the TLB
 * entries one by one at the granularity of 'stride'. If the TLB
 * range ops are supported, then:
 *
 * 1. If 'pages' is odd, flush the first page through non-range
 *    operations;
 *
 * 2. For remaining pages: the minimum range granularity is decided
 *    by 'scale', so multiple range TLBI operations may be required.
 *    Start from scale = 0, flush the corresponding number of pages
 *    ((num+1)*2^(5*scale+1) starting from 'addr'), then increase it
 *    until no pages left.
 *
 * Note that certain ranges can be represented by either num = 31 and
 * scale or num = 0 and scale + 1. The loop below favours the latter
 * since num is limited to 30 by the __TLBI_RANGE_NUM() macro.
 */
#define __flush_tlb_range_op(op, start, pages, stride,			\
				asid, tlb_level, tlbi_user)		\
do {									\
	int num = 0;							\
	int scale = 0;							\
	unsigned long addr;						\
									\
	while (pages > 0) {						\
		if (!system_supports_tlb_range() ||			\
		    pages % 2 == 1) {					\
			addr = __TLBI_VADDR(start, asid);		\
			__tlbi_level(op, addr, tlb_level);		\
			if (tlbi_user)					\
				__tlbi_user_level(op, addr, tlb_level);	\
			start += stride;				\
			pages -= stride >> PAGE_SHIFT;			\
			continue;					\
		}							\
									\
		num = __TLBI_RANGE_NUM(pages, scale);			\
		if (num >= 0) {						\
			addr = __TLBI_VADDR_RANGE(start, asid, scale,	\
						  num, tlb_level);	\
			__tlbi(r##op, addr);				\
			if (tlbi_user)					\
				__tlbi_user(r##op, addr);		\
			start += __TLBI_RANGE_PAGES(num, scale) << PAGE_SHIFT; \
			pages -= __TLBI_RANGE_PAGES(num, scale);	\
		}							\
		scale++;						\
	}								\
} while (0)

line_facts.claim_zh: 父版保持非叶TTL=0，但算法为页数低5位=1且scale=0的第一块生成num=0；1/33/65页会出现TTL/Num/Scale全零。非法性依据修复说明和同版注释，未独立对照硬件规范。
完整修复在非叶且(num_pages & 31)==1时先增加1页，保持未知层级TTL=0，而不是伪造叶TTL或退回非range；允许多失效一页的依据是修复说明，不是当前硬件执行。
命令构造器把Num/Scale/TTL/TG编码到硬件字段；这个opcode分支未检查全零三字段，所以软件内部参数的角落能传至实际命令字。batch_add调用构造器后记录命令。

causal_assessment.architecture_dimension_zh: CPU ISA范围在同版局限ARM64；4/16/64K是ARM64内配置；设备SMMUv3命令架构、IDR3.RIL/BTM、CPU与设备共同页表模式才是当前有证据的差异维度。
causal_assessment.implicit_contract_zh: 公共notifier提供有效字节范围；SVA提供未知层级的非叶语义，PAGE_SIZE是名义粒度。后端不能假定所有非叶范围都像io-pgtable整表范围一样有适合Num/Scale的尺寸，也不能将名义粒度推出具体TTL。
causal_assessment.propagation_zh: ARM64 TLB失效入口 → 公共MMU notifier分派 → SVA回调(end-start,PAGE_SIZE,false,!BTM) → ARM SMMUv3后端(TG/Num/Scale/TTL) → 命令队列；另一io-pgtable整表路径共享同一个后端，但输入形状更规整。传播方向是CPU/公共请求到设备后端，不是已证明的架构错误回流公共代码。
causal_assessment.exposure_zh: 有RIL且软件SVA失效、非零小范围/页数低5位为1时暴露旧非法编码；无RIL走单页命令，BTM开启绕开这条编码，叶失效或整表形状不会复现已有网格的这个三字段错误。它们是模式/输入对照，不是跨CPU架构A正常B失败。
causal_assessment.include_zh: 可纳入纵向隐含契约/设备协议边界案例，说明同一公共请求在具体硬件协议下如何被错误编码；作为严格CPU跨架构核心统计时应单列设备模式边界，不能混入有CPU A/B因果证据的案例。
not_established: 未建立另一CPU架构对同一公共场景的正常对照
未启动原/修复历史内核或执行SVA绑定、CPU TLB/MMU notifier完整链
未发送实际SMMU命令，未验证设备可见后果、具体芯片或errata

causal_assessment.method_guidance_zh: 自动检查应从公共回调真实注册和配置/设备功能门控开始，提取范围单位、结束边界、未知层级和硬件命令字段约束；分别检查请求覆盖、编码合法及非叶层级语义。范围不开启/BTM开启/单页与整表/完整与不完整修复构成模式对照，不能被包装成CPU架构对照。
